- Confirm which 1–2 models from the shortlist you want in the pilot (we recommend A and C for cost/latency trade-offs).

- Model A (67B quantized): good latency for short prompts, strong for structured extraction.
- Model B (13B finetuned): cheaper but may require longer context to match accuracy on multi-turn flows.
- Model C (34B q4_0): middle ground with reliable quality for 2–4k tokens.

Can you confirm by EOD Wednesday which models you want to prioritize for the pilot? If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min sync to walk through the tradeoffs.

Thanks Marissa — quick follow from product/ops perspective. A couple of pragmatic sizing points to help Brightleaf choose:

- If your average request payload (prompt + metadata) is <800 tokens and typical responses are <200 tokens, Model A will give the best latency/cost ratio for synchronous UI flows.
- If you have long thread summarization or multi-document prompts (2–6k token context), Model C is the safer pick; we should plan for slower tail latency and slightly higher VM counts.
- For bursty batches (e.g., nightly backfill), we recommend routing those to a cheaper queued path with larger batch sizes; we can include that in the MAP.

Action suggestions:
1) Sam: send a 24–48h token sample histogram for both interactive and background workloads.
2) Connor: prepare a quick runbook showing 95th / 99th token-latency estimates for Model A and Model C on 1x and 2x capacity.

I can host a 30m technical review tomorrow at 10am PT if that works for Brightleaf.

—Grace

Sam — great, thanks for the numbers and the sample. Based on the 950 + 250 token averages and your peak concurrency, here's the onboarding plan we agreed on for the pilot: 

Pilot scope (2 weeks):
- Primary model: Model C (34B q4) for the pilot flow (multi-doc summarization + UI).
- Secondary route: Model A (67B quantized) for low-latency UI paths where prompts <800 tokens.
- Routing policy: interactive requests routed to Model A by default when total context <800 tokens; otherwise route to Model C. Background batch jobs to run on a queued, batched path to maximize throughput.

Capacity & cost snapshot to prepare (Connor):
- 95th/99th token latency runs for Model A and Model C (1x and 2x capacity).
- Two-week token consumption projection with conservative 20% headroom: interactive + background combined ~ 18M tokens/week (estimate).
- Draft cost projection and recommended auto-scale thresholds.

Next steps / owners:
- Sam: confirm pilot start date (target week of 3/30) and approve MAP document. (owner: Sam)
- Connor: run perf tests and post results to the shared doc. (owner: Connor)
- Grace: prepare console alerts and 95th/99th trace dashboards for the pilot. (owner: Grace)
- Marissa: schedule weekly check-ins and own success criteria. (owner: Marissa)

If that aligns, I'll upload a revised MAP and the cost snapshot by Friday.

Cheers —
